contributions.detail: Page 2 (Form A) is entirely blank -- re-rendered at 200 dpi and again with -normalize to rule out faint pencil; not one inked line in the grid. Cover line 1 reads a hand-written numeral 0 in ALL THREE columns (LAST, THIS, CUMULATIVE), as does line 2. Zero rows therefore equals the cumulative cell and the this-period cell alike; the two scopes coincide, so scope is recorded cumulative. The Carr form prints no schedule total. This is a real zero, not a gap: the candidate reports raising nothing.

expenditures.detail: FILER OMISSION, retained verbatim and NOT repaired. Cover line 3 reports 0 (last) + 129.00 (this) = 129.00 (cumulative), but page 3 (Form B) is COMPLETELY BLANK -- checked at 200 dpi and again with -normalize, no ink anywhere in the 40-line grid. The schedule is provably empty, so the itemized set is complete-and-zero while the printed cover figure is 129.00: a 129.00 residual that is the filer's, not a transcription defect. There are no rows to publish and therefore no needs_review flags to set; the delta is recorded here and in notes. NEVER recomputed or overwritten -- the stated 129.00 stands as the form's own printed figure.

gates.page_subtotal: Neither Carr schedule prints a total or page subtotal, so the cover is the only anchor. Form A: 0 rows = cover line 1 '0' -- GATES. Form B: 0 rows vs cover line 3 CUMULATIVE '129.00' -- DOES NOT GATE; both figures named, no row adjusted.
gates.row_count: Counted by eye against ink on both schedules after -normalize: p2 Form A 0 inked bands of ~40, p3 Form B 0 inked bands of ~40. rowbands.py not needed -- with zero ink there is no row index to shift. 0 rows emitted on both sides.
gates.geometry_proof: Not applicable -- zero rows emitted on both sides.
gates.balance_chain: DOES NOT CLOSE, and the break is the filer's. Cumulative column: 0 contributions - 129.00 expenses = -129.00, but the printed line 4 balance is +129.00 (and the THIS column repeats 129.00). The filer appears to have copied the expenditure figure into the balance line rather than computing a negative (or zero) balance. Both figures transcribed verbatim into the anchor block; neither corrected.

escalation_note: 600 dpi tight crops of the cover money block, lines 1-2 and lines 3-4, to confirm (a) the marks on lines 1 and 2 are hand-written numeral zeros (closed ovals) and not dashes -- they are, so they are 0 per the zero-glyph ruling, and (b) the figure on line 3 THIS/CUM and line 4 THIS/CUM reads 129.00 and not 124.00 or 199.00. All four read '129.00' unambiguously at 600 dpi. No arithmetic anchor exists to cross-check them against, because the schedule is blank -- this is exactly the case where escalation cannot substitute for arithmetic, so the residual is reported as a delta rather than resolved.
